blocks.x: You say he was in the service and?

Well, he came out -- he come out rattled. He was real nervous. But Jo Jones, like, I don't know that people was aware of this. But the first time that I saw him, I couldn't stand him because he was with -- this was the night that I left home -- hoboed out here. I saw him that night. He would lift one eyebrow, smile, I'd say oh, he loves himself, you know, but this was a little idiosyncracy that he had because he had been in several mental institutions prior to that.
